lines.en: label springtime1:
scene ontherooftop1
So funny is the mockingbird, the way it mocks you so.
lines.zh: 嘲鸫多有趣啊，它是那样模仿着你。

lines.en: The way it commandeers your voice and shows you all you need to know.
lines.zh: 它征用你的声音，把你需要知道的一切都展示给你看。

lines.en: But when that mockingbird don’t sing — when you can’t find your voice.
lines.zh: 但当那只嘲鸫不再歌唱——当你找不到自己的声音。

lines.en: Just scream until your throat goes numb and drown your sorrows in the noise.
lines.zh: 那就一直尖叫，直到喉咙麻木，把悲伤淹没在噪音里。

lines.en: You were warned, yet you sat idly by- content to watch your days come to an end because you felt it would be an easier path.
lines.zh: 你被警告过，却袖手旁观——心安理得地看着自己的日子走向尽头，因为你觉得那是条更容易的路。

lines.en: Or perhaps you felt that you deserved it.
lines.zh: 又或者你觉得那是你应得的。

lines.en: But there was something you misunderstood.
lines.zh: 但有件事你误解了。

lines.en: It’s something you’ve been misunderstanding since the opening act.
lines.zh: 从开场那一幕起，你就一直在误解它。

lines.en: There’s this worm in the back of your head, biting chunks out of your malformed brain, and it makes you believe that everything always has to be about you.
lines.zh: 你后脑勺里有条虫，一口口咬着你畸形的脑子，它让你相信，一切都非得跟你有关。

lines.en: Even now, you’re probably thinking, “Why couldn’t it have been me instead?” But such thoughts have long since entertained us. And listening to you reiterate them sounds awfully boring.
lines.zh: 即便是现在，你大概也在想：「为什么死的不是我？」可这种念头我们早就玩腻了。听你一遍遍重复，实在无聊透顶。

lines.en: Don’t beat yourself up over it, big boy. This was long overdue.
lines.zh: 别为这个自责，大男孩。这一天早该来了。

lines.en: Frankly, that girl had it coming for being such an incorrigible, single-minded bitch all the time.
lines.zh: 说白了，那丫头活该——谁让她一直是那么个死不悔改、一根筋的贱人。

lines.en: And if my premonitions are correct, it is this exact turning of the tides that will help you swim your way back to shore and remember your rightful place in all of this.
lines.zh: 而如果我的预感没错，正是这一次潮水的转向，能帮你游回岸边，想起自己在这一切中应有的位置。

lines.en: Not as the main character.
lines.zh: 不是主角。

lines.en: Not as the hero.
lines.zh: 不是英雄。

lines.en: But as one of several manifestations of the falling action in a story that will never end.
lines.zh: 而是一个永不完结的故事里，「下降动作」的诸多化身之一。

lines.en: And while that may sound implausible or meaningless, your descent shows us otherwise. Your infinite falling is a priceless work of art in a universe left out of the light.
lines.zh: 虽然听起来不可思议又毫无意义，但你的坠落向我们证明了恰恰相反。你那无限的坠落，是一个被遗弃在光之外的宇宙里无价的艺术品。

lines.en: You will break for now. But soon, you will become the Collector.
lines.zh: 你暂时会崩溃。但很快，你就会成为收藏家。

lines.en: Let us pick from our teeth the muscle sinew and arteries, ripped clean from your arms as you carve them open in an effort to dig out the better memories, fake as they may be.
lines.zh: 让我们从牙缝里剔出那些肌肉、筋腱和动脉——当你为了挖出那些更好的记忆（哪怕它们是假的）而剖开自己的手臂时，它们被干净利落地撕了下来。

lines.en: Fill the void you dig out of your flesh with intangible beauty and it is {s}we{/i} I who will give it form. It is {i}I{/i} who will become your new reason to persist in a world in which you’re forced to.
lines.zh: 用无形之美填满你从血肉里挖出的空洞，而我，将赋予它形体。是{i}我{/i}，将成为你在这个被迫苟活的世界里坚持下去的全新理由。

lines.en: It’s so refreshing being free, isn’t it?
lines.zh: 自由的感觉真让人神清气爽，不是吗？

lines.en: It’s so refreshing being {i}you,{/i} isn’t it?
lines.zh: 做{i}你{/i}自己的感觉真让人神清气爽，不是吗？

lines.en: Not the person she wanted you to be. Not the person she groomed you into — a broken man incapable of dividing what little love he has left into boxes to share with everyone and everything.
lines.zh: 不是她想要你成为的那个人。不是她把你塑造出来的那个人——一个连仅剩的那点爱都无法分装成小盒子、分给身边所有人与事的残破男人。

lines.en: Didn’t your mother ever teach you that sharing is caring?
lines.zh: 你母亲没教过你，分享即是关怀吗？

lines.en: Didn’t she explain to you the worth of a human life? And how selflessness and devotion are two of the greatest follies known to man?
lines.zh: 她没跟你解释过一条人命的价值吗？没告诉过你，无私与奉献是人类已知最伟大的两种愚行吗？

lines.en: It is time to follow in her footsteps — to remember her many teachings and revisit the values you hold so close to your heart that you can’t help but overlook them in your ever-panicked permanence.
lines.zh: 是时候追随她的脚步了——重温她的诸多教诲，重访那些你珍视到几乎视而不见的价值观，在你那永远惊惶的恒常里。

lines.en: Because if you don’t, Akira-
lines.zh: 因为如果你不这样做，Akira——

lines.en: You really {i}will{/i} end up just like your father.
lines.zh: 你{i}真的{/i}会落得跟你父亲一模一样的下场。

lines.zh: : Maya 跟我说过，你这样的时候想把你叫醒是没用的，可是……可是有什么地方感觉不一样……关于你……

lines.en: Then, before you can tell her she’s a good girl and pat her on the head for a job well done, she’ll jump on top of you and kiss you, biting your lip and returning seminal fluid to the entity it was extracted from.

lines.en: The exchange rate might not be as inflated as you hoped given the fact that most of her blushing will now come from overexertion in a dimly lit bedroom- but red is red, is it not?
lines.zh: 汇率也许没你希望的那么夸张——毕竟她现在大部分的脸红，都来自昏暗卧室里的过度劳累了——但红就是红，不是吗？

lines.en: A hole is a hole, a tongue is a tongue, and a teenage pussy is a teenage pussy whether or not you delude yourself into thinking something as nonsensical as “love” is what secretes from it.
lines.zh: 洞就是洞，舌头就是舌头，十几岁的小穴就是十几岁的小穴，不管你自欺欺人地以为从里面分泌出来的东西是「爱」这种没道理的东西。

lines.en: So, why don’t you do us all a favor and man up already? Sitting there with your jaw agape and tears welling up in your creepy eyes isn’t going to get us any closer to finishing the collection, is it?
lines.zh: 所以，你就不能帮大家个忙，像个男人一点吗？张着嘴坐在那儿、眼泪在你那双变态的眼睛里打转，可没法让我们离完成收藏更近一步，对吧？

lines.en: Or perhaps I need to take something {i}else{/i} from you to spur you back to action?
lines.zh: 还是说我得从你身上再拿走点{i}别的{/i}什么，才能逼你重新行动起来？

lines.en: : Sensei, look at me. Talk to me. What happened? What did you see?
lines.zh: : Sensei，看着我。跟我说说话。发生了什么？你看见了什么？

lines.en: This one seems to be developing well. And she’s doing so in a way that isn’t utterly infuriating to watch like a certain wannabe protagonist.
lines.zh: 这个似乎成长得不错。而且她成长的方式，不像某个自以为是的主角那样看着让人火大。

lines.en: Go on. Tell her what you saw.
lines.zh: 说吧。告诉她你看见了什么。

lines.en: Tell her all that’s left — how her juices and scent still linger on your cock while her body swims through a sea of nothingness you’ll never get to set sail on.
lines.zh: 告诉她仅剩的一切——她的汁液和气味还残留在你的鸡巴上，而她的身体正游过一片你永远无法扬帆的虚无之海。

lines.en: Tell her how she called you by your name. Tell her about the smile on her face and the multiple orgasms and how sticking your cock inside her felt like adding the final piece to an infinite puzzle.
lines.zh: 告诉她，她是怎么喊出你的名字的。告诉她她脸上的笑容，那一次次的潮吹，还有把自己的鸡巴插进她体内时的感觉——像是给一幅无限的拼图添上了最后一块。

lines.en: Tell her how “in love” you were and maybe someone will grant you a miracle and bring her back.
lines.zh: 告诉她你有多么「坠入爱河」，说不定就会有人赐你一个奇迹，把她带回来。

lines.en: It won’t be me, though. And, without anyone else nearby right now, I can’t imagine you’ll have much luck.
lines.zh: 不过那个人不会是我。而现在身边又没有别人，我想你大概也不会有多少运气。

lines.en: : Sensei! Come on! You’ve gotta snap out of it! This isn’t the place for you to zone out like this! I need you!
lines.zh: : Sensei！拜托！你得振作起来！这儿可不是你发呆的地方！我需要你！

lines.en: scene ontherooftop8
Yeah. {i}Snap out of it.{/i} If I can learn how to break my textual pattern, surely {i}you{/i} can learn how to break whichever pattern makes you act like a hysterical little girl all the time.
lines.zh: 对。{i}振作起来。{/i}既然我都能学会打破自己的行文模式，{i}你{/i}当然也能学会打破那个让你一直表现得像个歇斯底里小女孩的模式。

lines.en: Is this truly what it means to be human? Does your human heart race with the intensity of a cheetah chasing after its prey? Do your human hands shake like a stargazer in the sand?
lines.zh: 这就是身为人类真正的含义吗？你那颗人类的心脏，会像猎豹追逐猎物那样狂跳吗？你那双人类的手，会像沙地里的观星者那样颤抖吗？

lines.en: Don’t get me wrong, I still want to work together. We both have so much to gain. I’m just not sure how effective you’ll be when you’re currently this...{i}childish.{/i}
lines.zh: 别误会，我还是想跟你合作。我们两人都有太多好处可拿。我只是不确定，你现在这么{i}幼稚{/i}，能有多大用处。

lines.en: But perhaps it is that aspect of your person that makes it so much more delightful to watch you fall. Truth be told, I haven’t had as much time to think about that as I’d like.
lines.zh: 但也正是你这一面，让看着你坠落变得格外有趣。说实话，我还没多少时间好好想过这一点。

lines.en: But that changes now.
lines.zh: 不过现在不一样了。

lines.en: Now, we’re going to be very good friends.
